_kabuni_verification_2026_07_10.file_creation_attribution: 'Who created file X' was computed with --full-history --diff-filter=A --reverse. WITHOUT --full-history git's path simplification silently misattributes creation to commit dfbd61d8 ('KPL_API_INTEGRATION_V0.1' by Gowthama K S), a single non-merge commit touching 868 files with 93,031 insertions - a squashed import of a long-lived feature branch. Under --full-history all four resolve to Ayush, 4-7 days earlier. This trap inverts the authorship of the payment gateway and the Entra auth extension. Always pass --full-history in this repo.
_kabuni_verification_2026_07_10.ai_assistance: 154 of 890 commits on origin/dev (17.3%) carry a 'Co-authored-by: Claude', 'Generated with Claude' or '[codex]' trailer. It is a team-wide norm, not specific to Ayush: Gowthama 84, Bhanuprakash 23, Mahesh 20, Sakshi 8, Ayush 6, Sagar 5, Srivani 4, Damini 4. kabuni.code_contradicted.reason: Audited against the kabuni-services tree on 2026-07-10. (1) ABAC: there are ZERO occurrences of 'abac', 'attribute-based', 'policy_engine', 'casbin' or any policy engine across apps/, packages/, charts/ and docs/. The authorization model is identifiable and it is hierarchical RBAC, not hybrid RBAC+ABAC: RbacService exposes set_role_parent / remove_role_parent / get_role_parent_ids / _assert_no_cycle, and auth_deps._collect_role_permissions walks role ancestors recursively to union permissions. That is NIST RBAC1 (role inheritance). No predicate anywhere evaluates a resource or subject attribute at decision time. The 'within six weeks' migration narrative has no commit trail either. (2) JWT lifetimes: no ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE / REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE constant exists in any service. The only '15' is SESSION_LOCKOUT_MINUTES in identity-service/src/core/config.py, which is a lockout window, not a token lifetime - this looks like the origin of the number. (3) Outbox: the pattern is real (kpl-service, order-service, payment-service) but was created by Gowthama K S (kpl 2026-05-21, order 2026-05-22). Ayush authored 11 of 20 commits touching outbox files, so he contributed substantially but did not implement it. 'Implemented' claims origination he does not have. (4) GitHub Actions: zero files under .github/workflows. The entire pipeline is Azure DevOps Pipelines under .azure/pipelines/, which Ayush is in fact the largest single contributor to (88/157 commits) - the claim is both wrong and weaker than the truth.
